findings.reason: the plan must name the one call site in the wiki scoring/chunk-writing path that invokes the rule, or the section ships surface that no run reaches.
findings.text: §3(b) says "the wiki scorer gains a dynamic-page rule", but the rule was built as five standalone helpers — detect_dynamic_page (:338), its private _is_header_only_form predicate, dynamic_page_stub (:353), fronts_databases_for_topic (:368) and apply_dynamic_page_rule (:396) — and grep over imas_codex/ (excluding tests) shows only the definition site and the __all__ list reference apply_dynamic_page_rule; scoring.py carries no call and the wiki pipeline never invokes it, so the complex behaviour §3 describes is spread across shallow functions that hide nothing behind a single entry point and are operator-invoked rather than pipeline-invoked

findings.reason: §9's done-when ("ingest_discovered_signals owns the DataAccess write and seed_worker carries no inline DataAccess MERGE") reverses a landed ordering fix unless the write is kept reachable with zero signals and the MDSplus branch produces a DataAccess the owner can take.
findings.text: §9(b) moves the DataAccess node write to "beside the edge merge in ingest_discovered_signals", but ingest_discovered_signals returns 0 at :2290 when its signal list is empty and its sole caller gates on `if result.signals` (:2584), so a scanner that returns access metadata without signals — exactly the case the landed §7 write at :2546 was placed to serve (its comment at :2546-2551 says so) — would lose its DataAccess writer; separately, the MDSplus branch constructs its DataAccess inline at :2483 and never produces the ScanResult.data_access the new argument requires, so the "one writer" cannot be reached from that branch either

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — §3's dynamic-page handling is a spread of five shallow helpers over one mechanism with no production entry point, so the interface §3 says the scorer gains delivers no behaviour.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §9(b) consolidates the DataAccess write onto ingest_discovered_signals, but that owner cannot hold the write for the thin-client case §7 deliberately separated, so the consolidation as written regresses a landed fix.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the only sections adding surface are §2 (three FacilitySignal slots plus the SignalDataClass enum) and §3 (the fronts_database property), and each states in its own text what it retires (the prototype class:/shots:/udpid: keyword parking) or why nothing can be retired (no existing WikiPage property records the database a rendered page is backed by).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the codebase it extends and cites the owners: §3 reuses link_chunks_to_entities and the existing WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal edge (imas_codex/discovery/wiki/pipeline.py:469, merge at :552-568) rather than adding a DOCUMENTED_IN edge, §3(c)/§2 extend the existing EDAS scanner (imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:53) rather than a sibling, and §10 extends remote.locations.resolve_service_url (imas_codex/remote/locations.py:206) by deleting the graph client's copy.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan removes wrappers rather than adding them: §9(a) collapses two probe call sites into one and §10 deletes _slurm_service_uri; where it does extend (§2 typed slots, §3 property), it justifies the extension against the mechanism it replaces.
